per_pair.question: What does Graham’s behavior in the chat suggest about how he responds to having his reading of a book challenged?
per_pair.blind_answer: Graham becomes defensive when his reading is contested and follows up the next day to relitigate it, using his speaking quirk “I actually thought it was rather good.” Blessing had to remind him discussion is not personal attack.
per_pair.score_rationale: Blind answer fully matches GT — defensive pattern, day-after follow-up, quirk language all identified.

per_pair.question: What does the conversation reveal about how thoroughly each member of the book club actually reads the books?
per_pair.blind_answer: Tomasz: most thorough, page-cites everything. Blessing: reads for craft, TLS-level engagement. Harriet: claims thorough, no page refs but insists on correct reading.
